reviews.text:
I would like to thank Espen and the team at Høvik, Ellen at the puppy course, Marianne at the basic course and Tor at the advanced course 1.
Lady has been able to learn in a safe environment with committed instructors, there have been city walks and forest walks, wet and dark evenings, brighter evenings and always a good mood.

I really appreciate being able to participate in the training group after having participated in 3 courses, where we can continue learning and gain inspiration from both instructors and other dog owners.

If there was anything to complain about, it is that the municipality cuts the lights in the winter without warning and then it becomes somewhat dark at the training area. 🔦

Thank you so much for your efforts. 🌸
Nice and pleasant instructors who follow up with course participants even after the course has ended.
Great courses with skilled instructors. The dog training you get access to after completing the courses is gold.
The nicest dog shop in Oslo 😍 …

I often visit the store at Ljabru to buy treats for my dog. Good selection at very nice prices. Friendly and pleasant staff who seem to have control.
Recommended!!
Trond who shops on behalf of his hovawart
Extremely nice, knowledgeable and they have a good selection of food and snacks. Always helpful with trimming the dog's nails.

I have attended puppy classes and follow-up classes and was very satisfied both times with both the instructors and the program. I always go to the store to have my dogs' claws clipped and find that everyone who works there is skilled and experienced.
Always pleasant, personal follow-up and good advice. Sells quality goods.
